title: Easy Chicken and Potatoes
reject_reason: Plain lemon-pepper baked chicken thighs with potatoes and carrots is the same roast-chicken-and-potatoes dinner as live parmesan-garlic-sheet-pan-chicken-potatoes across all four structural axes (chicken/bake/potato/plain); only the seasoning differs and this is the more generic version.
